text: You'll love this Tomato and Basil Orzo Salad recipe because it perfectly fits your dietary preferences and time budget. As a vegetarian, you'll appreciate the absence of meat, and the use of fresh basil and tomatoes ensures a delicious and flavorful dish. The recipe is also nut-free, so you don't have to worry about any allergens. With a cooking time of just 35 minutes, you can have this tasty salad ready in no time, making it an ideal choice for a quick and satisfying meal.
